about: Hand-computed constraint measures (spec 041, 3.4.5 and 3.4.6), each over one case. The constraint is named c, over the ranking r of the shortlist parameter list, on the attribute city; params are extra Integer parameters. cases is the one case's measure (null when excluded); a mean is num/den, computed as one binary64 division; breakdown is the whole exclusion count; the metric value is constraint/c's.

cases.name: all_at_k, one unknown attribute, no failure (section 5, row 9)
cases.arithmetic: x: FR/Paris against FR/Paris, the first 2 elements equal: satisfied. z has no city: unknown. No item fails, one is unknown: the case is excluded, unknown_attribute.

cases.name: all_at_k, reference absent, no item failing (section 5, row 10)
cases.arithmetic: requested holds no city, so nothing is checked: excluded, no_reference.

cases.name: all_at_k, one unknown attribute and one failure (section 5, row 11)
cases.arithmetic: x satisfied; y: FR/Lyon against FR/Paris fails at element 2; z unknown. One known failure decides the case: 0/1.

cases.name: all_at_k, every item satisfies
cases.arithmetic: x satisfied, nothing else in the top 5: 1/1; the metric is 1/1.

cases.name: all_at_k over an empty list (section 5, row 12)
cases.arithmetic: no item in the top 5: excluded, empty_ranking, never vacuously 1.

cases.name: path_prefix: 2 against a one-element path (section 5, row 13)
cases.arithmetic: the reference FR has no element 2, so the first 2 elements cannot match: x fails, 0/1.

cases.name: all_at_k checks only the top k
cases.arithmetic: k = 1: only x is checked and satisfies; y, which would fail, is beyond k: 1/1.

cases.name: equals against an Integer parameter and a path attribute (section 5, row 15)
cases.arithmetic: x's city is a path and the reference is the Integer 4: no comparison of two kinds, so x is unknown and the case excluded, type_mismatch.

cases.name: no gold items
cases.arithmetic: the gold record has no items: excluded, no_gold.

cases.name: share_at_k counts items and means cases
cases.arithmetic: x: Paris is a member, satisfied; y: Nice is not, fails; z: a path against text values, type_mismatch; w: no city, unknown_attribute. Checked items x and y: 1/2, the case's mean.

cases.name: share_at_k with no checked item
cases.arithmetic: z: type_mismatch; w: unknown_attribute. No checked item, so 0/0 is never a mean: excluded, no_checked_items.

cases.name: share_at_k, equals between gold values of one kind
cases.arithmetic: x: Paris equals Paris, satisfied; y: the Integer 3 against text, type_mismatch. Checked items x: 1/1.
